0:
set -Eeuo pipefail

rm -rf /config/claude /config/codex /config/opencode /config/t3code.toml
mkdir -p /config/claude /config/codex /config/opencode
install -m 0644 /run/config/t3code.toml /config/t3code.toml
install -m 0644 /run/config/claude-settings.json /config/claude/settings.json
install -m 0644 /run/config/codex-config.toml /config/codex/config.toml
install -m 0644 /run/config/opencode.jsonc /config/opencode/opencode.jsonc

mkdir -p /data/home/.config/mise
install -m 0644 /run/config/mise.toml /data/home/.config/mise/config.toml

install -d -m 0700 /data/home/.ssh
python3 /run/config/normalize-openssh-key.py \
  /run/secrets/git-signing/id_signing \
  /data/home/.ssh/id_signing
install -m 0644 /run/secrets/git-signing/id_signing.pub /data/home/.ssh/id_signing.pub
install -m 0644 /run/config/gitconfig /data/home/.gitconfig
printf '%s %s\n' \
  "$(git config -f /data/home/.gitconfig user.email)" \
  "$(cat /data/home/.ssh/id_signing.pub)" \
  > /data/home/.ssh/allowed_signers
chmod 0644 /data/home/.ssh/allowed_signers

mkdir -p /data/t3/userdata
if ! jq -e . /data/t3/userdata/settings.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  install -m 0600 /run/config/t3-selection.json /data/t3/userdata/settings.json
fi

mkdir -p /data/claude-home
if ! jq -e . /data/claude-home/.claude.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '{}\n' > /data/claude-home/.claude.json
fi
jq -s 'map(select(type == "object")) | reduce .[] as $doc ({}; . * $doc)' \
  /data/claude-home/.claude.json \
  /run/config/claude-mcp.json > /tmp/claude-merged.json
install -m 0600 /tmp/claude-merged.json /data/claude-home/.claude.json
rm -f /tmp/claude-merged.json

export HOME=/data/home
export CODEX_HOME=/data/codex
mkdir -p "$CODEX_HOME"
install -m 0644 /run/config/codex-config.toml "$CODEX_HOME/config.toml"
codex plugin marketplace remove memini >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
codex plugin marketplace add eleboucher/memini \
  || echo "codex plugin marketplace unavailable; memini reaches Codex over MCP"
codex plugin add memini@memini \
  || echo "codex plugin install unavailable; memini reaches Codex over MCP"

koment_plugin_stage="$(mktemp -d)"
koment_plugin_tag="$(
  awk -F '"' '$2 == "github:koment-dev/koment" { print $4; exit }' \
    /data/home/.config/mise/config.toml
)"
if [ -n "$koment_plugin_tag" ]; then
  koment_plugin_version="$(printf '%s' "$koment_plugin_tag" | sed 's/^v//')"
  koment_plugin_archive="koment-plugin-codex_$koment_plugin_tag.tar.gz"
  koment_plugin_checksums="$(
    printf 'koment-plugins_%s_checksums.txt' "$koment_plugin_version"
  )"
  if gh release download "$koment_plugin_tag" \
    --repo koment-dev/koment \
    --pattern "$koment_plugin_archive" \
    --pattern "$koment_plugin_checksums" \
    --dir "$koment_plugin_stage" \
    && (
      cd "$koment_plugin_stage"
      awk -v archive="$koment_plugin_archive" '$2 == archive' \
        "$koment_plugin_checksums" | sha256sum --check -
    ); then
    mkdir -p "$koment_plugin_stage/marketplace"
    tar -xzf "$koment_plugin_stage/$koment_plugin_archive" \
      -C "$koment_plugin_stage/marketplace" \
      --strip-components=1
    rm -rf /data/home/.local/share/koment/codex-marketplace
    mkdir -p /data/home/.local/share/koment
    mv "$koment_plugin_stage/marketplace" \
      /data/home/.local/share/koment/codex-marketplace
    codex plugin marketplace add \
      /data/home/.local/share/koment/codex-marketplace \
      || echo "codex plugin marketplace unavailable; koment reaches Codex over MCP"
    codex plugin add koment@koment-dev \
      || echo "codex plugin install unavailable; koment reaches Codex over MCP"
  else
    echo "koment Codex plugin archive unavailable; koment reaches Codex over MCP"
  fi
else
  echo "koment version missing from mise config; koment reaches Codex over MCP"
fi
codex plugin list || true

export CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/data/claude-home
for marketplace in eleboucher/memini koment-dev/koment; do
  claude plugin marketplace add "$marketplace" \
    || echo "claude plugin marketplace $marketplace unavailable"
done
for marketplace in memini koment-dev; do
  claude plugin marketplace update "$marketplace" \
    || echo "claude plugin marketplace $marketplace update unavailable"
done
for plugin in memini@memini koment@koment-dev; do
  claude plugin install "$plugin" \
    || echo "claude plugin install $plugin unavailable"
  claude plugin update "$plugin" \
    || echo "claude plugin update $plugin unavailable"
done
claude plugin list || true

agent_kit_home=/data/home/.local/share/agent-kit
agent_kit_installed=$agent_kit_home/installed
agent_kit_skill_roots="$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills $HOME/.agents/skills"
agent_kit_stage="$(mktemp -d)"
agent_kit_archive="agent-kit_$AGENT_KIT_VERSION.tar.gz"
agent_kit_checksums="$(
  printf 'agent-kit_%s_checksums.txt' \
    "$(printf '%s' "$AGENT_KIT_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//')"
)"
if gh release download "$AGENT_KIT_VERSION" \
  --repo janpuc/agent-kit \
  --pattern "$agent_kit_archive" \
  --pattern "$agent_kit_checksums" \
  --dir "$agent_kit_stage" \
  && (
    cd "$agent_kit_stage"
    awk -v archive="$agent_kit_archive" '$2 == archive' \
      "$agent_kit_checksums" | sha256sum --check -
  ); then
  mkdir -p "$agent_kit_stage/release"
  tar -xzf "$agent_kit_stage/$agent_kit_archive" \
    -C "$agent_kit_stage/release" \
    --strip-components=1
  for previously_installed in "$agent_kit_installed"/skills/*/; do
    [ -d "$previously_installed" ] || continue
    for skills_root in $agent_kit_skill_roots; do
      rm -rf "$skills_root/$(basename "$previously_installed")"
    done
  done
  for skills_root in $agent_kit_skill_roots; do
    mkdir -p "$skills_root"
    cp -a "$agent_kit_stage/release/skills/." "$skills_root/"
  done
  rm -rf "$agent_kit_installed"
  mkdir -p "$agent_kit_home"
  mv "$agent_kit_stage/release" "$agent_kit_installed"
  echo "agent-kit $AGENT_KIT_VERSION skills installed"
else
  echo "agent-kit release unavailable; skills stay at the last provisioned batch"
fi
rm -rf "$agent_kit_stage"

set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME=/data/home
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/data/home/.config
export XDG_DATA_HOME=/data/home/.local/share
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/data/home/.cache
export MISE_INSTALL_PATH=/data/home/.local/bin/mise
export MISE_YES=1

mkdir -p /data/home/.local/bin
if [ ! -x "$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" ]; then
  curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh
fi

cd /data/home
"$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" install --yes \
  || "$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" install --yes
"$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" reshim

if koment_bin=$("$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" which koment); then
  ln -sf "$koment_bin" /data/home/.local/bin/koment
else
  echo "koment not installed by mise; koment MCP will be unavailable"
fi

"$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" ls --installed

[Lidarr]
api_key = $${LIDARR_API_KEY}
host_url = http://lidarr.media.svc.cluster.local
download_dir = /media/Downloads/soulseek/complete
disable_sync = False

[Slskd]
api_key = $${SLSKD_API_KEY}
host_url = http://slskd.downloads.svc.cluster.local
url_base = /
download_dir = /media/Downloads/soulseek/complete
delete_searches = False
stalled_timeout = 3600
remote_queue_timeout = 300

[Release Settings]
use_selected_lidarr_release = False
use_most_common_tracknum = True
allow_multi_disc = True
accepted_countries = Europe,Japan,United Kingdom,United States,[Worldwide],Australia,Canada,Portugal
skip_region_check = False
accepted_formats = CD,Digital Media,Vinyl

[Search Settings]
search_timeout = 5000
maximum_peer_queue = 50
minimum_peer_upload_speed = 0
minimum_filename_match_ratio = 0.8
minimum_search_interval = 5
allowed_filetypes = flac,mp3 320,mp3
ignored_users =
album_prepend_artist = False
search_type = incrementing_page
number_of_albums_to_grab = 10
title_blacklist =
search_blacklist =
search_source = missing
failed_import_denylist = True

[Download Settings]
download_filtering = True
use_extension_whitelist = False
extensions_whitelist = lrc,nfo,txt

[Logging]
level = INFO
format = [%(levelname)s|%(module)s|L%(lineno)d] %(asctime)s: %(message)s
datefmt = %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z
log_to_file = True
log_file = soularr.log
max_bytes = 1048576
backup_count = 3
